content.comment_body: Hello, I have configured the system as shown. The outputs labeled AM display the values I entered on the screen, but the Ax value remains zero. Am I missing something?

It's important to note that the values shown in the smaller table under the block reflect only simulation results, not the actual current online values. To view the real-time online values, select the relevant block, look for the small glasses icon, click it, and an output field with the current online value will appear. Please see the video attached for clarification.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble distinguishing between simulation data and actual online hardware values in the [company_name] software interface. The platform shows configuration and simulation data, but does not make clear that the actual device outputs are accessible through a different process, resulting in confusion about the status of live values.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that the values visible on the configuration screen correspond to real-time hardware data, rather than simulated outputs.
